title: Import Animal ID (RGA)
intro: Choose the PDF card you downloaded from the SinPatinhas website. The app fills in the profile for you to review. Nothing is saved before you confirm.
accepted: We accept the 1-page PDF (up to 5 MB). If you only have a photo or screenshot of the card, or of the collar tag, that works too: the app reads the QR code and fills in only the RGA.
privacy: Your file is sent only to read the data and is not stored. The owner's tax ID (CPF/CNPJ) is never saved or shown.
notRecognized: I did not recognize this file as a SinPatinhas Animal ID.
partial: I filled in what I could and marked it "check". Review everything and complete what is missing.

reasons.not_a_pdf: The file does not look like a PDF.
reasons.too_large: The file is larger than 5 MB.
reasons.multiple_pages: The PDF has more than one page. The card has only 1 page.
reasons.unexpected_page_size: The page size is different from the card's.
reasons.unreadable: I could not read the file. It may be damaged.
reasons.missing_required_fields: Essential data is missing (name, RGA or species).
reasons.qr_not_found: I did not find a SinPatinhas QR code in the image.

warnings.rga_format: The RGA has a format different from what we know (XXX.XXXX.X-UF). Please check it, but you can still save it.
warnings.microchip_confirm: The document has a value in the microchip field. Please confirm it is the chip number.
warnings.qr_mismatch: The QR code's RGA differs from the RGA printed on the document. This file may have been altered. Use "Validate on SinPatinhas" before trusting it.
warnings.qr_missing: I did not find the expected QR code in the document.
warnings.qr_unexpected: The document has a QR code that is not from SinPatinhas. It was ignored.
warnings.creator_unexpected: This document's layout seems different from what we know. Please check the data carefully.
warnings.date_invalid: A date was unreadable or out of order (birth, issue, today) and was not filled in.
warnings.phone_invalid: The owner's phone does not look like a full area code and number.
warnings.place_invalid: A city/state was unreadable and was not filled in.
warnings.value_unrecognized: Some value was not recognized (e.g. species, sex). Please fill it in manually.
warnings.ignored_items: The document had text in unexpected places. It was ignored.

review.photo: Use the ID photo as the profile picture
review.tutor: Also save the owner's name and phone shown on the ID
review.tutorHint: Optional. The tax ID (CPF/CNPJ) is never saved.

duplicate.title: This RGA is already registered
duplicate.body: You already have a pet with this RGA: {{name}}. Instead of creating another one, you can update its profile. Here is what would change:
duplicate.noChanges: The file's data is the same as the profile.

errors.unsupported: Choose a PDF, a photo (JPG) or a screenshot (PNG).
errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB. Choose a smaller one.
errors.network: No connection. The file must be uploaded to be read; try again with internet.
errors.accountRequired: To import the ID, sign in with an account (email, Google or Apple).
errors.generic: Could not read the file right now. Please try again.

validateHint: Opens the government's official website to check this RGA.
qrMismatchSaved: When importing, the file's QR code did not match the RGA. Validate on the official website before trusting this profile.
